name: Circle of the Land

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A druid drawing on one land's magic, with spells that change by terrain and Land's Aid to heal and harm at once.

feature.name: Circle of the Land Spells
feature.summary: After each Long Rest choose arid, polar, temperate or tropical land; its circle spells are always prepared.
feature.text: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, choose a type of land: arid, polar, temperate or tropical. You always have that land's spells prepared once your Druid level reaches the level shown. Arid: Blur, Burning Hands and Fire Bolt (3), Fireball (5), Blight (7), Wall of Stone (9). Polar: Fog Cloud, Hold Person and Ray of Frost (3), Sleet Storm (5), Ice Storm (7), Cone of Cold (9). Temperate: Misty Step, Shocking Grasp and Sleep (3), Lightning Bolt (5), Freedom of Movement (7), Tree Stride (9). Tropical: Acid Splash, Ray of Sickness and Web (3), Stinking Cloud (5), Polymorph (7), Insect Plague (9).

options.name: Arid Land
options.summary: Blur, Burning Hands and Fire Bolt; Fireball at 5, Blight at 7, Wall of Stone at 9.

options.name: Polar Land

feature.name: Land's Aid
feature.summary: Magic action, spend Wild Shape: a 10-foot sphere deals 2d6 Necrotic (Con save halves) and one creature in it regains 2d6 Hit Points.
feature.text: As a Magic action you can expend a use of Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of you. Life-giving flowers and thorns fill a 10-foot-radius sphere there: each creature of your choice in it makes a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success, and one creature of your choice in the area regains 2d6 Hit Points. Both grow to 3d6 at Druid level 10 and 4d6 at 14.

feature.name: Natural Recovery
feature.summary: Once per Long Rest cast a circle spell without a slot; once per Long Rest recover spell slots when you finish a Short Rest.
feature.text: You can cast one of your level 1+ Circle of the Land spells without expending a spell slot, and you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. In addition, when you finish a Short Rest you can recover expended spell slots whose levels add up to no more than half your Druid level (round up), none of them level 6 or higher; once you do, you can't again until you finish a Long Rest.

feature.name: Nature's Ward
feature.summary: Immunity to the Poisoned condition and Resistance to a damage type tied to your current land.

feature.name: Nature's Sanctuary
feature.summary: Magic action, spend Wild Shape: a 15-foot cube of spectral trees gives you and allies Half Cover and your land's Resistance.
